title: After Your Turn
can_do: 请求同伴之后的一轮，商定最后一次滚球，等约定完成后接过球并开始自己的回合。
trigger: Dad is rolling the only ball. Child asks for the following turn, and Dad requests one last roll first.
setting: The two of them sit close together on a clear home play mat and share one ball.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Watch me roll the red ball.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have a turn after you?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Can I roll it once more first?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: You first, then me. I'll watch how you roll it.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: That was my last roll. Here you go.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thanks. Now I roll it back to you.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I'll catch it with both paws.

replay_cards.title: Turn with the marker
replay_cards.change: Dad is finishing a sun with the only yellow marker and thinks Child is asking to take it immediately
replay_cards.challenge: Child requests the next turn. When Dad offers the marker before finishing, Child repairs with "No, I mean after your turn." Dad chooses one last ray as the endpoint; Child agrees to wait. Dad draws the ray and hands over the marker, then Child thanks him and begins a yellow flower.

replay_cards.title: Turn with the rolling pin
replay_cards.setting: Making pretend food from play dough
replay_cards.change: Dad is flattening one piece of dough with the only rolling pin; Child wants it for a separate piece
replay_cards.challenge: Ask for the next turn. Dad requests one final pass over his dough, and Child confirms "You first, then me." Dad completes that pass and puts the pin within Child's reach. Child takes it, thanks Dad, and starts rolling his own piece while Dad shapes the flattened dough by hand.

parent_support: Play Dad's request for one final roll as a real, finite preference. Child can agree on the order without grabbing or being pressured to smile.
Complete exactly the agreed roll, then hand over the ball. Keep the short handoff distinct from Child's first roll so both turns are visible.
